mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 3.5% and PAYEMS growth accelerates (> 200k new jobs per month), a tightening labor market fuels wage pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to anticipated inflation.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month increase in INDPRO, indicating supply chain resilience, supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as manufacturers' profitability improves.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.025 over any 4-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of INDPRO growth (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds $800k, signaling robust consumer spending, and HOUST simultaneously rises above 1600 (indicating housing market strength), a synergistic demand boost leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 45% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in CPIAUCSL over 2 consecutive months, indicating easing price pressures, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real interest rates become more attractive.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of declining CPIAUCSL (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the level of UNRATE, as a standalone indicator of labor market conditions, predicts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, with lower rates associated with positive returns due to the implied economic growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns do not show a significant negative correlation with UNRATE levels (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of early-cycle expansion, a 1-month increase in HOUST above 1400 signals improving consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances during early-cycle expansions, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 4-year rolling window.
